title: Doritos Chicken Casserole
description: This Doritos chicken casserole is loaded with shredded cheese and salsa for a guaranteed crowd-pleasing dish featuring everyone's favorite chips.
ingredients: 1 (14.5 ounce) package nacho cheese-flavored tortilla chips (such as Doritos®), crushed
2 cups shredded Mexican cheese blend, divided
1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly spray a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Spread crushed chips out on the bottom of the prepared baking dish.
Stir chicken, 1 cup cheese, salsa, corn, condensed soups, and sour cream together in a bowl. Pour chicken mixture over crushed chips into the baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Spread remaining 1 cup cheese over the casserole and bake until cheese is melted and bubbling, about 5 minutes more.
